newsitem.title: INDIA: WSC-India and Pakistan Cotton Weather, Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: WSC-India and Pakistan Cotton Weather, Sept 18.

text.p: SUMMARY- Showers 0.05-0.80 inch (1-20 mm), 60 percent coverage, in southern and central India. Dry to the north. Highs 82-99F (28-37C).
CROP IMPACT- Mostly favorable conditions across the major cotton areas of Pakistan and India at this time.
TODAY...Variable clouds with light to moderate showers 0.10-0.75 inch (3-19 mm) in southern and central India, 50-60 percent coverage. Fair to the north. Highs 82-98F (28-37C).
TONIGHT...Lingering showers south, showers ending central areas, and generally dry north. Lows 68-78F (20-25C).
TOMORROW...Light to moderate showers again over southern and central India with dry weather to the north including Pakistan. Highs again 82-98F (28-37C).
OUTLOOK...Showers in the south, fair in the north, with seasonable to warm temperatures Friday through Sunday.
